```artifact
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Admin
    participant LabIncharge
    participant Chemist
    participant Patient
    participant System
    participant Heroku
    participant MySQL
    participant HospitalWebsite
    participant Browser

    Admin->>HospitalWebsite: Access Hospital Website
    HospitalWebsite->>System: Authenticate Admin
    System->>Admin: Display Dashboard
    Admin->>System: View Invoice and Reports
    System->>MySQL: Query Invoice and Reports
    MySQL->>System: Return Invoice and Reports Data
    System->>Admin: Display Invoice and Reports

    LabIncharge->>HospitalWebsite: Access Hospital Website
    HospitalWebsite->>System: Authenticate LabIncharge
    System->>LabIncharge: Display Lab Management Interface
    LabIncharge->>System: Perform Lab Test (Offline)
    System->>MySQL: Update Lab Test Report
    System->>LabIncharge: Confirm Lab Test Completion
    LabIncharge->>System: Update Prescription Flag (Online)
    System->>MySQL: Update Prescription Flag

    Chemist->>HospitalWebsite: Access Hospital Website
    HospitalWebsite->>System: Authenticate Chemist
    System->>Chemist: Display Delivery Interface
    Chemist->>System: Deliver Medicine (Offline)
    System->>MySQL: Update Delivery Status
    System->>Chemist: Confirm Delivery Completion
    Chemist->>System: Update Prescription Flag
    System->>MySQL: Update Prescription Flag

    Patient->>HospitalWebsite: Access Hospital Website
    HospitalWebsite->>System: Authenticate Patient
    System->>Patient: Display Invoice and Reports
    System->>MySQL: Query Invoice and Reports
    MySQL->>System: Return Invoice and Reports Data
    System->>Patient: Display Invoice and Reports

    Note over System: System deployed on Heroku with MySQL 5.7.21
    Note over HospitalWebsite: Accessible via multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, etc.)
    Note over System: Supports OS: Windows, Unix, Linux, macOS
    Note over System: Invoice and Prescription Reports can be printed anytime
    Note over System: Designed to prevent full scan of Patient Consultation Request Entity for next day/day range appointments
```
